question: Numerical validity and tolerance/time-resolution sensitivity of the original Canopy13 synthetic radial AC case.

sources.use: radial current summation method, oriented ordering; no code copied
branch-flow balance context only; no optimization theorem asserted

rights: Original project synthetic Canopy13 generator/data, AGPL-3.0-only; no third-party feeder dataset

design.core: 48 baseline-only cases; unmodified load/solar scales 1; full Cartesian product
design.additional: One original seed17/96-step example with all four provided policies; no-load and analytic resistive 2-bus (24 steps each); one seed17/24-step baseline with max_iterations=1 to retain expected FAILED_SOLVER
design.time_comparator: 288 intervals per day at matching seed/tolerance, finest sampled resolution, not exact temporal ground truth
design.solver_comparator: 1e-12 sweep at matching seed/resolution; independent nodal rectangular Newton for every solved interval of all scenarios
design.baseline: Idle storage, zero tap; profile seeds modify hourly solar cloud factors only

reference.method: Independently authored rectangular nodal Newton solves V_i conjugate(sum_j Y_ij V_j)+S_load_i=0. Analytic Jacobian; partial-pivot Gaussian elimination; flat start; no calls to producer or evaluator. Compute losses by Re(sum end powers) and source using Ybus.
reference.analytic_control: 2-bus r=0.1,x=0,p=0.1 pu, V=(1+sqrt(1-4rp))/2; loss=r(p/V)^2 Sbase; no-load V=slack, losses=0

outcomes: All scenario/policy feasibility states and exclusion reasons
Complex voltage, source complex power and interval loss discrepancies versus Newton
Power residual <=1e-7 pu and total energy residual <=1e-6 kWh per frozen evaluator
Seed-specific energy, peak source import, minimum voltage, maximum branch loading across resolutions
Runtime CPU/wall seconds, output bytes, package/build/runtime/input/result hashes
uncertainty: Finite deterministic min/max ranges over three chosen seeds and four resolutions; no stochastic confidence intervals, population estimates, novelty, physical validity or human/peer-review claims
falsifiers: Any tight-tolerance independent comparison exceeding its bound
Any analytic control disagreement exceeding 1e-8 pu voltage or 1e-6 kW loss
Any invalid or failed case reported as feasible
Temporal differences too large for an intended future use are unresolved, not erased
stopping_rule: Run fixed 52 scenarios/55 combinations once in prescribed order. Retain every CLI stdout/stderr and failed/invalid state. Stop at 240 measured CPU seconds to reserve analysis, never exceed 300 CPU seconds, 120 scenarios,480 intervals; no adaptive favorable selection. One CPU child at a time. Root informed of any scientific blocker.
execution_note: Root disclosed rc1 campaign decoder 1MiB ceiling before confirmation; use per-case run for substantive results and a two-case campaign for CLI coverage; source package unchanged. Two-case campaign uses two core cases in place of standalone runs.
